responsibilities: Translate business requirements and logic into scalable, version-controlled data models using dbt within cloud data warehouse environments
Design, build, and maintain high-performance Tableau or similar BI dashboards and certified Published Data Sources
Develop and maintain reliable semantic models to ensure critical business metrics are consistently defined and calculated across the organization
Work with cross-functional business metrics including ARR, Churn, NPS, Pipeline Velocity, and Attrition
Implement and maintain data quality and freshness testing to ensure the reliability of enterprise data products
Build and maintain business glossaries and data lineage within Data Catalog platforms to improve data discoverability
Structure and optimize data products for machine learning consumption and augmented intelligence applications
Collaborate with Data Engineering, IT, and Security teams to manage upstream data source changes, RBAC governance, and PII masking
Partner with stakeholders across multiple business functions to understand data requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions
Proactively identify opportunities to improve data models, analytics capabilities, reporting consistency, and overall data quality

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Implement and maintain data quality and freshness testing to ensure the reliability of enterprise data products
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Quality, testing, governance and reliability language runs throughout with no speed or shipping language at all, anchored by "data quality and freshness testing to ensure the reliability of enterprise data products".
evidence.domain_risk: Collaborate with Data Engineering, IT, and Security teams to manage upstream data source changes, RBAC governance, and PII masking
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Consequences are wrong business metrics and access/PII exposure rather than regulated financial reporting, so "RBAC governance, and PII masking" lands this at moderate rather than high.
evidence.data_team_maturity: join our Client's global data organization
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The role joins a "global data organization" with separate Data Engineering, IT and Security counterparts and an existing Data Catalog and certified-data-source practice, which is mature rather than growing.
evidence.jd_authorship: Work with cross-functional business metrics including ARR, Churn, NPS, Pipeline Velocity, and Attrition
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Named tools and named metrics in application context ("ARR, Churn, NPS, Pipeline Velocity, and Attrition") make the day-to-day legible, which reads as hiring-manager authorship.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Develop and maintain reliable semantic models to ensure critical business metrics are consistently defined and calculated across the organization
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Most bullets build the shared modelling, semantic and catalog layer others consume - "semantic models to ensure critical business metrics are consistently defined" - so the primary audience is the data layer itself.
evidence.autonomy_level: Proactively identify opportunities to improve data models, analytics capabilities, reporting consistency, and overall data quality
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role owns metric definitions and "proactively identif[ies] opportunities to improve" while most bullets still "translate business requirements" handed over by business functions, so both modes are present.
evidence.ai_role: Structure and optimize data products for machine learning consumption and augmented intelligence applications
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate builds data products that ML and augmented-intelligence systems consume downstream, which is the enabler pattern rather than using AI tools themselves.
evidence.testing_framing: Implement and maintain data quality and freshness testing to ensure the reliability of enterprise data products
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing appears as an owned responsibility bullet with action verbs ("Implement and maintain data quality and freshness testing"), not as a tool in a skills list.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: transform raw data into scalable, trusted, and certified data products
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Trust framing sits in the role summary - "trusted, and certified data products" - and repeats through certification, quality testing, lineage, RBAC and PII masking, so the dominant fear is untrustworthy data reaching the business.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Design, build, and maintain high-performance Tableau or similar BI dashboards and certified Published Data Sources
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Build verbs are paired with maintain and improve on an existing stack in nearly every bullet, so neither greenfield nor fix dominates.
evidence.loss_aversion: The role summary frames the output as "scalable, trusted, and certified data products", with certified Published Data Sources, freshness testing, lineage, RBAC governance and PII masking all named as controls.
